request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
The sage sofa fits the room’s earthy palette: a sandy-beige rug, walnut and oak browns, terracotta seating, brass accents and warm off-white walls.

I can’t confirm the floor match because no render or floor finish is included. If it’s warm natural wood or beige stone, the muted sage should complement it nicely.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter cream rug colour could give the sofa more definition without changing the palette. Nothing has been changed.
